tutorial.step1.title: Welcome to the Future of Trading!
tutorial.step1.content: You've been given a demo account with $150 in virtual funds to get started. Let's walk through how it works.
tutorial.step2.title: Real Trading, Virtual Funds
tutorial.step2.content: This is the most important part: while your funds are for demonstration, the trading is 100% real, using live market data. The profit or loss shown is exactly what you would have achieved with a real money account.
tutorial.step3.title: Your AI Trading Partner
tutorial.step3.content: You won't be trading manually. Your partner is a sophisticated AI robot designed to analyze markets and execute trades automatically.
tutorial.step4.title: Choose Your Strategy
tutorial.step4.content: Select a robot that matches your style. 'Risk Averse' is for safety, 'Balanced' offers steady growth, and 'High Growth' aims for maximum returns (and carries higher risk).
tutorial.step5.title: Activate the Robot
tutorial.step5.content: Once you've chosen your AI partner, press the 'Start Trading' button to let it begin working on the live market.
tutorial.step6.title: Time is Ticking
tutorial.step6.content: Your AI robot can trade for a total of 4 hours. After this time, the demo session will end. Use this time wisely to see its full potential!
tutorial.step7.title: Watch and Withdraw
tutorial.step7.content: You can now see the results in the 'Trade History'. Remember, if this were your real account, you could withdraw your profits at any time. Ready to start? Good luck!

info.title: Platform Information
info.aboutPlatform.title: About the Facebook AI Platform
info.aboutPlatform.subtitle: An innovative project from Meta, designed for automated trading using artificial intelligence.
info.aboutPlatform.p1: You are using a unique platform that allows you to evaluate the performance of our AI algorithms on real market data without any financial risk. Your demo account is a full-fledged tool for demonstrating the capabilities of our technology.
info.aboutPlatform.p2: The profit or loss you see in the 'Trade History' is a 100% real reflection of what would have happened if you were trading with real funds. This allows you to transparently assess the effectiveness of your chosen robot.
info.realAccount.title: Activating a Real Account
info.realAccount.content: To start earning real money and withdraw profits, you need to activate a real account. This is done by making a minimum deposit of ${amount}. Contact your manager via chat to get help.
info.realAccount.advantages.title: Advantages of a real account:
info.realAccount.advantages.p1: Ability to withdraw all your profits at any time.
info.realAccount.advantages.p2: Access to a personal manager and 24/7 support.
info.realAccount.advantages.p3: Exclusive trading strategies and analytical tools.
info.license.title: Licenses and Regulation
info.license.p1: Our activities are carried out in full compliance with international financial legislation. We are licensed by leading world regulators, which guarantees the safety of our clients' funds and the transparency of all operations.
info.license.p2: This multi-jurisdictional approach allows us to provide high-quality services worldwide, adhering to the strictest standards of safety and professional ethics.
info.aboutMeta.title: About Meta's Technology
info.aboutMeta.p1: Facebook AI is a flagship project of Meta, developed by a team of leading experts in the field of artificial intelligence and financial markets. Our mission is to make advanced trading technologies accessible to everyone.
info.aboutMeta.p2: We use the latest developments in machine learning and big data analysis to create AI robots capable of adapting to any market changes and making profitable trading decisions. Your success is our main priority.
info.support.title: Need help?
info.support.content: Our support is available 24/7. Use the chat button in the bottom right corner to contact us with any questions. We are always ready to help!
info.footer.warning: Trading in financial markets involves a high level of risk and may not be suitable for all investors.
info.faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
info.faq.q1.question: Is the profit I see real?
info.faq.q1.answer: Yes, absolutely. Although you are using virtual funds, the trading occurs on real markets with real-time data. The profit and loss you see are exactly what you would get on a real account.
info.faq.q2.question: How can I start earning real money?
info.faq.q2.answer: To switch to real trading and be able to withdraw your profits, you need to activate a real account. This requires a minimum deposit of ${amount}. After the deposit, all profits will be yours to withdraw.
info.faq.q3.question: Are my funds safe?
info.faq.q3.answer: Yes. We operate under the strict supervision of several international financial regulators. Client funds are kept in segregated accounts at top-tier banks, ensuring their safety.
info.faq.q4.question: Do I need to know how to trade?
info.faq.q4.answer: Not necessarily. Our platform is designed so that the AI robot does all the analytical and trading work for you. Your task is to choose a robot whose strategy suits you and monitor the results.
